name: AffineDeFi
fix_description: In receiveFlashLoan, validate that userData cannot specify LoanType.upgrade with an arbitrary newStrategy address. The upgrade path should only be callable by an authorized admin, not triggered via flash loan callback. Fix: add require(loan != LoanType.upgrade) in the flash loan callback, or verify newStrategy against a whitelist/governance-approved address.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is extremely short and consists of just two Balancer flashLoan calls with crafted calldata to the vulnerable contract, plus a stub callback. It does not require complex multi-protocol routing, deep accounting analysis, or a long exploit chain, so a competent auditor could reproduce it quickly once the missing validation/trust issue is identified.
